kebab_example: aliyun pds create-share-link --drive-id 1 --share-all-files true --file-id-list 9520943DC264 --user-id u123 --share-pwd abcF123x --expiration 2020-06-28T11:33:00.000+08:00 --description Lecture_collection --share-name LectureRoom-1.MP4 --disable-preview false --disable-save false --disable-download false --preview-limit 100 --save-limit 100 --download-limit 100 --require-login true --office-editable true --creatable true --creatable-file-id-list 9520943DC264 --api-version 2022-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateShareLink

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to share all files in the drive
parameters.help_zh: 是否分享整个drive中的文件
parameters.name: share_all_files

parameters.help_en: A list of 1 to 100 file IDs to share. This parameter is required when `share_all_files` is `false` and is ignored when it is `true`
parameters.help_zh:
分享父路径文件id列表。
父路径文件个数范围[1, 100]。
如果`share_all_files=true`，那么此字段无效，否则必须要填写
parameters.name: file_id_list

parameters.help_en: The user ID. This parameter is required when authenticating the request with an AccessKey (AK)
parameters.help_zh: 用户id。使用AK方式请求时，必填
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The password for the share link. It must be between 0 and 64 printable ASCII characters. If this parameter is not set or is an empty string, the share link does not require a password
parameters.help_zh:
提取码。
提取码长度范围[0, 64]字节
不设置或者设置为空表示无提取码，在获取分享令牌的时候也不用设置提取码参数。
要求使用ASCII可见字符
parameters.name: share_pwd

parameters.help_en: The expiration time for the share link, specified in RFC 3339 format (for example, "2020-06-28T11:33:00.000+08:00"). To create a share link that never expires, set this parameter to an empty string ("")
parameters.help_zh:
失效时间点。
RFC3339格式，比如："2020-06-28T11:33:00.000+08:00"。
当expiration取值""时，表示永久有效
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: A description for the share link, 0 to 1,024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
分享描述。
长度范围[0, 1024]字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The share name. The length must be between 0 and 128 characters. If not specified, the system uses the name of the file corresponding to the first ID in `file_id_list`
parameters.help_zh:
分享名。
如果未设置，默认使用file_id_list中的第一个id对应的文件名。
长度范围[0, 128]字符
parameters.name: share_name

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to prevent users from previewing the shared files
parameters.help_zh: 禁止预览分享中的文件
parameters.name: disable_preview

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to prevent users from saving the shared files to their own drive
parameters.help_zh: 禁止转存分享中的文件
parameters.name: disable_save

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to prevent users from downloading the shared files
parameters.help_zh: 禁止下载分享中的文件
parameters.name: disable_download

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of times users can preview the shared files. The value must be 0 or greater. A value of 0 means there is no limit
parameters.help_zh:
分享预览次数限制。
次数要求>=0。
次数0表示不限制
parameters.name: preview_limit

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of times users can save the shared files. The value must be 0 or greater. A value of 0 means there is no limit
parameters.help_zh:
分享转存次数限制。
次数要求>=0。
次数0表示不限制
parameters.name: save_limit

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of times users can download the shared files. The value must be 0 or greater. A value of 0 means there is no limit
parameters.help_zh:
分享下载次数限制。
次数要求>=0。
次数0表示不限制
parameters.name: download_limit

parameters.help_en: If `true`, users must log in to access the share link
parameters.help_zh: 登录后才允许访问分享
parameters.name: require_login

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to allow online editing of the shared documents
parameters.help_zh: 允许在线编辑分享的文档
parameters.name: office_editable

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to allow users to create files in shared folders. Setting this to `true` also requires specifying `creatable_file_id_list`
parameters.help_zh: 允许在分享中的文件夹中创建文件；creatable为true时，需要同时传creatable_file_id_list参数
parameters.name: creatable

parameters.help_en: A list of folder IDs where users can upload files
parameters.help_zh: 允许上传的文件夹file id列表
parameters.name: creatable_file_id_list
